title: Insight into the Inhibitory Mechanism of Embryonic Ectoderm Development Subunit by Triazolopyrimidine Derivatives as Inhibitors through Molecular Dynamics Simulation.
authors: Ju, Jianan; Zhang, Hao; Guan, Shanshan; Liu, Chang; Du, Juan; Shen, Xiaoli; Wang, Song
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过分子动力学模拟分析三唑并嘧啶类抑制剂与EED亚基的结合机制，属于蛋白质-小分子抑制剂互作，而非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题TF-DNA结合机制研究无关。
abstract: Inhibition of the Embryonic Ectoderm Development (EED) subunit in Polycomb Repressive Complex 2 (PRC2) can inhibit tumor growth. In this paper, we selected six experimentally designed EED competitive Inhibitors of the triazolopyrimidine derivatives class. We investigated the difference in the binding mode of the natural substrate to the Inhibitors and the effects of differences in the parent nuclei, heads, and tails of the Inhibitors on the inhibitory capacity. The results showed that the binding free energy of this class of Inhibitors was close to or lower compared to the natural substrate, providing an energetic basis for competitive inhibition. For the Inhibitors, the presence of a strong negatively charged group at the 6-position of the parent nucleus or the 8'-position of the head would make the hydrogen atom on the head imino group prone to flip, resulting in the vertical movement of the parent nucleus, which significantly decreased the inhibitory ability. When the 6-position of the parent nucleus was a nonpolar group, the parent nucleus would move horizontally, slightly decreasing the inhibitory ability. When the 8'-position of the head was methylene, it formed an intramolecular hydrophobic interaction with the benzene ring on the tail, resulting in a significant increase in inhibition ability.
abstract_zh: 抑制Polycomb Repressive Complex 2 (PRC2)中的胚胎外胚层发育（EED）亚基可抑制肿瘤生长。本文选取了六种实验设计的三唑并嘧啶衍生物类EED竞争性抑制剂，研究了天然底物与抑制剂结合模式的差异，以及抑制剂母核、头部和尾部差异对抑制能力的影响。结果表明，该类抑制剂的结合自由能接近或低于天然底物，为竞争性抑制提供了能量基础。对于抑制剂而言，母核6位或头部8'位存在强负电性基团会使头部亚氨基上的氢原子易于翻转，导致母核垂直移动，显著降低抑制能力。当母核6位为非极性基团时，母核会水平移动，抑制能力略有下降。当头部8'位为亚甲基时，其与尾部苯环形成分子内疏水相互作用，导致抑制能力显著增强。
